verdict.rationale: The official justica.gov.pt service page documents the whole incorporation online. A founder can create a sociedade unipessoal por quotas, por quotas or anónima, authenticate via Cartão de Cidadão, Chave Móvel Digital or eIDAS, and have the pacto social auto-generated and signed in-platform. Payment is by MBWay, Multibanco or card within 48 hours, and on completion the founder receives the cartão eletrónico and certidão permanente codes. The 404 on the eportugal.gov.pt entry URL is a stale link, not evidence the transaction fails, since the live guidance and service sit on justica.gov.pt. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end online incorporation, and a working published eportugal entry path.
